class_id: a write the door REFUSED is read by its caller as a write that LOST, so the caller neither moves to its next candidate nor stops asking the refused one
feature: any caller that decides its next step from a writer's result (the pull walk's agreement check against the consolidator's field result), where the writer has more than one way to not store a value: kept a better-ranked value, refused this value on a rule, dropped the write
symptom: the writer refuses a value (a validation rule, a merged-record rule) and returns the stored value with the incoming source as its result. The caller compares only (chosen source, final value) against what it sent, sees a mismatch, and classifies it the one way it knows: a priority loss. A priority loss is 're-ask next slot, do not try another source', so the refused value is offered again every slot (a new failure row each time, until an attempts cap) and the lower-ranked source that could supply a valid value is never written. Nothing fails: the field just stays empty under the wrong reason code. Universal shape: a result that collapses several distinct non-acceptance causes into one comparison makes every new cause inherit the handling of the old one
